slug: 2025-08-21 Niger inaugurates a new Internet Exchange Point (IXP)

facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports that Niger inaugurated a new Internet Exchange Point in Niamey on 19 August 2025, opened by the Minister of Communication and New Information Technologies, as a place where ISPs interconnect directly to exchange traffic locally; no member count is given.

note: The only exchange point named is CENIX in the Central African Republic; nothing on an exchange point in Niger.

facts.fact: ANP, citing the Smart Villages project (PVI), reports that the project achieved the creation of Niger's first Internet Exchange Point with the operator Niger Telecoms, improving the resilience of data exchange and the quality of internet traffic; the article gives no launch date or member count, so the date is the article's own (15 April 2026).

systems.owner: Smart Villages project (PVI) with Niger Telecoms

note: The IXP is listed among critical infrastructure the new committee will oversee for deployment; the article does not say it is in service.

facts.fact: Le Sahel reports the Minister of Communication inaugurated Niger's internet exchange point on 19 August 2025, where internet providers interconnect and exchange traffic, built under the PVI programme by a Nigerien firm.
